sources.text:
Schlaube Valley Nature Park is a nature park and reserve in the state of Brandenburg, Germany. It covers 225 square kilometres (87 mi2). It was established on December 27, 1995.

With a surface area of 1.32 square kilometres (0.51 mi2), the Großer Müllroser See, through which the river Schlaube flows, is its largest lake.
